method.paths: Production Vite builds; real createTableProvider TypeScript and Rust Web Workers. Common client validation, clone, worker transport, Rust wire conversions, Wasm startup and response publication included.
method.cache: Fresh worker each observation; browser HTTP cache warmed by parity and 3 warmups. Not cold network.
method.order: Sequential alternating engine order per paired iteration; no concurrent executor workloads. Driver transfers the exact tagged wire as one JSON string, parsed before the timed harness begins; pre-transfer JSON roundtrip is independently checked. This avoids driver serialization overhead, not executor work.
method.boundaries: Factory, acquire including startup, initial apply, sequential first 100-row block then totals, total cold-load-ready; restore initial definition outside each warm pivot or sort/filter edit; edit apply and block/totals-ready; full pulled export from restored initial definition.
method.parity: Before any timing: each action and full export against independent calculateView baseline and cross-engine view/block/export metadata. Only requestId and transferId transport identifiers excluded. Exact structural keys, row IDs/order, values/errors/formats, columns, totals and export metadata; 1e-12 relative/absolute numeric tolerance for explicit output column IDs whose published aggregation is mean or whose aggregate formula AST is division, at row/totals values locations only; source fields, metadata, errors, formats and signed zero remain exact.
method.statistics: Median (average central pair), nearest-rank p95; individual observations in chronological engine order. Warmups discarded.
method.uiPaint: Not measured: no shared renderer harness. Separate future UI/device acceptance gate.
method.memory: Not measured: browser worker allocator/process peaks unavailable; 20k representative desktop workload is not an iPad limit.
method.activation: TypeScript remains default; desktop evidence only; regular iPad/device acceptance outstanding.
